title: Autumn Azalea
description: This resourcepack replaces the normal azalea on a autumn (orange) azalea!
body:
Autumn Azalea (Resourcepack)
A lightweight addition that transforms standard azalea leaves and bushes into vibrant autumn trees. Perfect for creating a cozy atmosphere without changing every biome in the game.
Shader in gallery - BSL.
